primary_heading.family: Playfair Display, ui-serif, Georgia, Cambria, Times New Roman, Times, serif
primary_heading.style: Oversized, tight tracking (tracking-tighter), bold and expressive. Used for extreme scale (text-6xl to text-9xl). Avoid Inter for headings entirely.

technical_annotation.family: JetBrains Mono, ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace
technical_annotation.style: Typewriter/OS aesthetic. Used for metadata, diagrams, timestamps, UI labels, small caps (tracking-widest).

body.style: Clean, highly legible, stays out of the way. Generous line-height (leading-relaxed).

rules: NO generic rounded sans-serifs for headings.
Mix extreme scales: Pair a massive text-8xl Serif heading with a tiny text-xs Mono annotation directly underneath.
Never center align body text. Strict left-alignment (ragged right) for editorial feel.

linen.usage: Primary background for the entire site. Brings the 'paper/editorial' feel. Never use pure white.

chocolate_brown.usage: Primary text color, borders, raw SVG lines, diagrams. Replaces standard black/gray.

tangelo.usage: Kinetic accents, primary CTA buttons, highlighted data points, interactive hover states. Use for 'What I notice -> What I do' signals.

botticelli.usage: Secondary backgrounds, softer structural blocks, quiet contrast to the warm Tangelo.

rules: NO gradients. NO glassmorphism. NO soft shadows. Keep it flat, raw, and printed.
Hover states should invert colors (e.g., hover:bg-[#663924] hover:text-[#F9E8D4]).

layouts.spacing: Extremely generous. Use p-12, p-16, p-24 to create massive negative space. The site must feel like a magazine spread.
grids: Asymmetrical Tetris Grid: Do not make symmetrical 3-column cards. Use col-span-8 and col-span-4 to create tension.
Borders instead of Cards: Use strict 1px solid #663924 borders to separate sections, reminiscent of editorial columns or OS panels.
layouts.alignment: Prioritize harsh left alignment and intentional offsets. Elements should occasionally overlap slightly to break the grid.

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid #663924. Use border-collapse for grid sections.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle SVG noise overlay (opacity-20) over the #F9E8D4 background to make it feel like printed linen/paper.
visual_enhancers.shadows: NO soft drop shadows. If depth is needed, use harsh solid offset shadows (e.g., shadow-[4px_4px_0px_#663924]).
visual_enhancers.corners: Sharp (rounded-none) or very slightly rounded (rounded-sm) for interactive elements. NO excessive rounded cards.

motion.scrolling: MUST install and implement 'lenis' for smooth scrolling. This provides the premium 'momentum' feel.
motion.hero_reveal: Framer Motion line-by-line masked text reveal for 'I HAVE BUILT AUDIENCES / THINGS / LEGOS'.
motion.parallax: One subtle parallax moment on scroll using Framer Motion (use-scroll).
motion.interactions: Hover states on diagrams/radar should trigger immediate, sharp reveals (no long fades). Press-on nail and artifacts should reveal on hover/click with raw HTML absolute positioning.
motion.marquee: Use react-fast-marquee. Extremely slow, editorial ribbon style. Mono font, #663924 text on #F9E8D4.

media.rules: NO STOCK PHOTOGRAPHY. NO AI BLOBS. NO CORPORATE ILLUSTRATIONS.

components.rules: Use raw HTML/Tailwind for layouts. If using Shadcn (e.g., Dialog for writing samples), strip ALL default Vercel-like styling (no rounded-lg, no shadows). Overwrite with border border-[#663924] bg-[#F9E8D4] rounded-none.

testing.attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute to facilitate robust automated testing. Convention: kebab-case, role-based.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building an editorial portfolio that merges physical magazine aesthetics with technical operating system interfaces.
Do NOT use standard SaaS cards. Rely on borders (border-[#663924]), padding, and typography scale for hierarchy.
Ensure 'lenis' is installed and used for smooth scrolling.
Ensure 'framer-motion' is used for the masked text hero reveal.
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds for any overlapping content or modals. Always use solid #F9E8D4 or #8DB6C7.
Do not add any stock photos. Only use the provided user assets.
Tone is curious, direct, smart, self-aware, slightly funny, a little weird. Embed this in the UX microcopy.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Make this creative, distinctive, and editorial.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Embrace asymmetry and ragged-right text.
Create depth through overlapping layers and raw borders, NOT glassmorphism or soft shadows.
NEVER use universal transitions (transition: all). Target specific properties.
NEVER use AI assistant emoji characters.
Every interaction needs a micro-animation (e.g., text color inversion on hover).
Prioritize optical alignment and extreme negative space (p-16 to p-32).
